_meta.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash leaderboard mining — 13 cross-leaderboard scores from AA + arena.ai + MathArena + WebDev Arena
_meta.context: User asked us to mine reference leaderboards for additional benchmark scores covering the 4 newly-added Session 19 models. Subagent systematically checked AA Intelligence Index, LMArena/arena.ai (all sub-categories), LiveBench, MathArena, Aider, Epoch ECI, Scale SEAL, OpenRouter, VBench, Bambooshi. Result: gemini-3.5-flash has appeared on 3 third-party leaderboards (AA model detail page, arena.ai text + WebDev, MathArena Final-Answer Comps) — 13 NEW score triples extractable. Gemini Omni Flash absent everywhere (vendor's deferred-to-API note confirmed). Qwen 3.7 Max + Plus Preview have only their existing arena.ai entries — no additional coverage on AA/LiveBench/MathArena/etc.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION — values verbatim from leaderboard DOM (Playwright-verified). Skipped: gdpval_aa AA=58% vs existing PDF=1656 Elo (metric encoding mismatch), hle AA=41% rounded vs existing 40.2% Google primary, mmmu_pro AA=84% rounded vs existing 83.6% Google primary. All preserved-existing scores are from Google's deepmind.google primary source which takes precedence over AA chart rounding.
